title.en: Before fusion: specify an energy-forecast baseline
title.zh: 多源融合之前：先把能源预测基线做清楚

summary.en: Define the target, available inputs, chronological splits and error slices before comparing forecasting models.
summary.zh: 先写目标、输入可用时间、时间切分与分组误差，再比较模型。附一份可以直接照着准备的实验清单。

basis.en: A proposed first-experiment protocol informed by FPP3, ERA5 documentation and TimeSeriesSplit. It contains no newly measured forecasting results.
basis.zh: 结合 FPP3、ERA5 文档与 TimeSeriesSplit 整理的首个实验准备方案，尚未报告新的预测性能结果。

paragraphs.en: Example task specification: at each hourly issue time, predict power one hour ahead for one site, using only inputs released by that issue time. This is an illustrative setup; a real dataset must establish the site, frequency, units and availability delay.
paragraphs.zh: 任务设定示例：每个整点发出预报，预测某站点一小时后的功率，只使用当时已发布的输入。这只是示例设定；真实数据还要落实站点、频率、单位和发布延迟。

bullets.en: Record site_id, issue_time, target_time, available_at, value, unit and quality_flag. Keep timezone explicit.
bullets.zh: 记录 site_id、issue_time、target_time、available_at、value、unit 和 quality_flag，明确时区。

bullets.en: Separate missing observations, sensor faults and operational curtailment. A power value near zero is not automatically an invalid record.
bullets.zh: 区分观测缺失、传感器故障与限电工况。接近零的功率不一定是坏数据。

title.en: 02 / Keep simple models in the comparison

paragraphs.en: Persistence predicts the last available power value. A seasonal baseline uses the same time on the previous day. Both may fail during rapid weather changes, but they make the added value of a complex model measurable. The seasonal interval must match the actual sampling frequency.
paragraphs.zh: 持续性基线使用最近可获得的功率；季节性基线使用前一天同一时刻的功率。天气突变时它们可能失效，但保留它们，才能判断复杂模型增加了什么。季节间隔必须与采样频率一致。

paragraphs.en: If a required historical input is missing, mark the baseline as unavailable or apply a predeclared fallback. Compare models on a common valid subset and also report their availability over all requested predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 历史输入缺失时，标记基线不可用，或使用事先约定的降级方式。模型误差应在共同有效样本上比较，同时报告全部请求中的结果可用率。

title.en: 03 / Split by issue time, protect the target window
title.zh: 03 / 按发出时间切分，检查标签窗口

paragraphs.en: Use chronological training, validation and final test periods. Fit imputers, scaling and feature selection on the training period only. For a forecast at t with labels through t+h, ensure that no training label reaches into the validation period. An embargo should follow the horizon and data-release rules.
paragraphs.zh: 按时间安排训练、验证与最终测试区间。填补、标准化与特征选择只在训练期拟合。对于 t 发出、标签延伸至 t+h 的样本，要确保训练标签没有越入验证期；隔离区长度应由预测跨度和发布规则决定。

paragraphs.en: TimeSeriesSplit provides ordered folds and a gap, but does not validate forecast availability, site grouping or delayed revisions for you. Its equal-spacing assumption matters when comparing test folds of equal duration.
paragraphs.zh: TimeSeriesSplit 提供顺序折叠和 gap，但不会替你检查预报可用性、站点分组或迟到修订。若要比较相同时长的测试折，还需注意等间隔样本这一前提。

title.en: 04 / Show the error distribution, not just one mean
title.zh: 04 / 平均误差之外，再看几个切片

bullets.en: Report MAE and RMSE with the power unit. If normalizing by installed capacity, state the capacity source and how changes over time are handled.
bullets.zh: 报告带功率单位的 MAE 和 RMSE；若按装机容量归一化，应说明容量来源及容量变化的处理。

bullets.en: Avoid unqualified MAPE near zero power. Inspect daylight/nighttime, forecast horizon and high-change intervals separately, with sample counts and an event threshold chosen before testing.
bullets.zh: 低功率接近零时，不能直接依赖 MAPE。分别查看白天／夜间、预测跨度和快速变化时段，并报告样本数；事件阈值在测试前约定。

bullets.en: If adding prediction intervals later, report empirical coverage together with interval width. A narrow band alone is not evidence of reliability.
bullets.zh: 后续加入预测区间时，同时报告实际覆盖率和区间宽度；窄区间本身不能证明可靠。

title.en: 05 / Before adding sources, plan how they can fail
title.zh: 05 / 加入多源数据，也要设计缺源验证

paragraphs.en: A useful comparison matrix is: power history only; history plus weather; history plus weather with delayed or missing weather inputs. Keep the chronological split and target definition fixed. Randomly masking cells is not a substitute for realistic outages of an entire source.
paragraphs.zh: 可准备三组对照：仅功率历史；历史加气象；历史加气象但存在气象延迟或缺失。三组保持时间切分和目标定义一致。随机遮掉几个单元格，不能代替整路来源中断。

paragraphs.en: Save the split manifest, source versions, configuration, prediction table and failure cases before writing a conclusion. These are planned artifacts; this note does not claim that a fusion model has already improved performance.
paragraphs.zh: 下结论前保存切分清单、来源版本、配置、预测明细和失败案例。这些是待完成的实验产物，本篇不声称融合模型已经取得提升。
